en.askTitle: Swap in your own photos and needs, and get the same hands-on comparison of free background removers
en.runTitle: A small online seller tests free background removers on six photos, without signing up

fields.label: Image subjects
fields.value: a mug on a busy table, curly hair, a glass bottle, a white sneaker on white, a plush toy, a bicycle with thin spokes

fields.label: Personal or commercial use
fields.value: small online seller who needs clean product photos

fields.label: Required output size
fields.placeholder: e.g. at least 1000 px on the long edge for marketplace listings

fields.label: Account and upload preferences
fields.value: no account sign-up, no payment, no personal photos, fresh signed-out browser

fields.label: How often I need exports
fields.placeholder: e.g. about 20 product photos a week

en.template: Compare background-removal options for {subjects}, {use}, {size}, {account} and {frequency}. Separate completed results from blocked or untested flows, check permissions and tell me what needs manual cleanup. Plan only; do not create accounts, pay or publish.

phases.title: Prepare six test photos, fix the scoring rules in advance and start testing the tools side by side
phases.note: Licensed photos, a scoring sheet and parallel tests of local and web tools
phases.judgment: One colleague re-checked a note about the stock mug photo, found it wrongly called a cup, and corrected the record. The white sneaker is a locally drawn illustration, and the plan says so openly.

phases.title: Keep testing in a clean browser and record what each tool allows
phases.note: Sign-in prompts, blocked pages and free-tier limits written down as found
phases.judgment: When Adobe’s page refused access it was recorded as “access blocked”, not as a proven sign-in requirement. Photoroom’s stalled runs were left unscored rather than labelled as needing an account.

phases.title: Look at every result, then build the comparison page, tables and sources, and check once at the end
phases.judgment: The final answer separates scored results from blocked or untested ones: login-blocked quality is “unscored, not zero”, and the sneaker illustration and unverified free-tier limits are listed as limitations.

workers: Found six freely licensed photos (and drew the sneaker), saved the licence evidence and checked every image decodes unchanged
Set up the open-source tool rembg on this computer and ran all six photos through it, timing each one
Tested Adobe Express, Canva and Clipdrop in a clean browser, stopping wherever a sign-in or block appeared
Tested Photoroom and Pixlr in a clean browser and saved the six Pixlr results with timings

zh.askTitle: 把图片和需求换成你的，免费抠图工具就按你的情况实测比较
zh.runTitle: 小型网店卖家用六张照片实测免费抠图工具，全程不注册账号

fields.label: 图片主体
fields.value: 桌上杂乱背景里的马克杯、卷发人像、玻璃瓶、白底白鞋、毛绒玩具、细辐条自行车

fields.label: 个人还是商用
fields.value: 小型网店卖家，需要干净的商品图

fields.label: 需要的输出尺寸
fields.placeholder: 例如：长边至少 1000 像素，用于平台上架

fields.label: 是否接受账户和上传
fields.value: 不注册账号、不付款、不上传个人照片，用干净的浏览器环境

fields.label: 导出频率
fields.placeholder: 例如：每周大约 20 张商品图

zh.template: 请按{subjects}、{use}、{size}、{account}、{frequency}比较抠图选择。分清已完成、受阻和没测到的结果，核对使用权限，告诉我哪里还要手工修整。只做计划，不开户、不付款、不发布。

phases.title: 备好六张测试照片、先定好评分标准，并同时开测各个工具
phases.note: 授权可用的照片、评分表，以及本地工具和网页工具的并行测试
phases.judgment: 有位同事回头检查库存照片，发现自己把马克杯错记成了杯子，随即改正记录。白色运动鞋是本地画的示意图，方案里也明说了。

phases.title: 在干净的浏览器里继续测试，记录每个工具的限制
phases.note: 登录提示、被拦截的页面和免费版限制，都照实记下
phases.judgment: Adobe 页面拒绝访问时，只记作“访问被拦截”，没当成一定要登录；Photoroom 反复卡住的几次也没打分，没有硬说它需要账号。

phases.title: 逐一查看结果，做出对比页、表格和来源清单，最后统一检查一遍
phases.judgment: 最终回答把有分数的结果和受阻、没测到的分开：被登录挡住的画质算“未评分，不是零分”，运动鞋是示意图、免费版限制没核实，也都列为局限。

workers: 找来六张可免费使用的照片（运动鞋自己画了一张），留好授权证据，并确认每张图都能原样打开
在本机装好开源工具 rembg，把六张照片都跑一遍并逐张计时
在干净的浏览器里测试 Adobe Express、Canva 和 Clipdrop，遇到登录或拦截就停下
在干净的浏览器里测试 Photoroom 和 Pixlr，并保存 Pixlr 的六张结果和耗时
